name: allchat-streamdeck-plugin
description: Elgato Stream Deck plugin for All-Chat: send chat messages and drive polls / predictions from hardware keys.
//dependencies: The build toolchain sits in dependencies rather than devDependencies on purpose. This package is private and never published, and CI runs with NODE_ENV=production, under which npm ci omits dev dependencies and npm run build would fail with 'tsc: not found'. Nothing listed here ships to a user: the distributable is the .sdPlugin folder, which contains only the compiled bin/ and the manifest.
